legend: Consider an array A with N elements, all being the same integer a.

Define the product transformation as a simultaneous update Ai = Ai·Ai + 1, that is multiplying each element to the element right to it for ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bab7e22f732dff71f7d64d3ebfc08bb437dcd67f.png), with the last number AN remaining the same. For example, if we start with an array A with a = 2 and N = 4, then after one product transformation A = [4,  4,  4,  2], and after two product transformations A = [16,  16,  8,  2].
Your simple task is to calculate the array A after M product transformations. Since the numbers can get quite big you should output them modulo Q.
input: The first and only line of input contains four integers N, M, a, Q (7 ≤ Q ≤ 109 + 123, 2 ≤ a ≤ 106 + 123, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2ac3dce719aaa3202862fcb75cce57e5994e48b1.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) is prime), where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) is the multiplicative order of the integer a modulo Q, see notes for definition.
output: You should output the array A from left to right.
note: The multiplicative order of a number a modulo Q ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38b13c1f6db75ae72784f8602e8230429b26cf2a.png), is the smallest natural number x such that ax mod Q = 1. For example, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64b53b8160eddc004a5b65223bf29dd636bb1832.png).

legend.ai: 考虑一个包含 N 个元素的数组 A，其中所有元素均为同一个整数 a。

定义乘积变换为同时进行更新 Ai = Ai·Ai + 1，即将每个元素乘以其右侧的元素 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bab7e22f732dff71f7d64d3ebfc08bb437dcd67f.png)，其中最后一个数 AN 保持不变。例如，若初始数组 A 的 a = 2 且 N = 4，则进行一次乘积变换后，A = [4,  4,  4,  2]；进行两次乘积变换后，A = [16,  16,  8,  2]。
你的简单任务是计算经过 M 次乘积变换后的数组 A。由于这些数可能会变得很大，你应当输出它们对 Q 取模的结果。

input.ai: 输入的第一行也是唯一一行包含四个整数 N、M、a、Q(7 ≤ Q ≤ 109 + 123，2 ≤ a ≤ 106 + 123，![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2ac3dce719aaa3202862fcb75cce57e5994e48b1.png)，![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) 为素数)，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) 是整数 a 模 Q 的乘法阶，定义见注释。

output.ai: 你应当从左到右输出数组 A。

note.ai: 数 a 模 Q 的乘法阶 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38b13c1f6db75ae72784f8602e8230429b26cf2a.png) 是满足 ax mod Q = 1 的最小自然数 x。例如，![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64b53b8160eddc004a5b65223bf29dd636bb1832.png)。
